_comment: The News tab. One entry per day, newest first, written once a day by the scheduled task 'WoW Forever daily news (gear planner)'. Sections in this order when they have items: 'Game' (hotfixes, patch notes, fixed quests, announcements), 'WoWSims' (changes to the simulator). Nothing about this site's own changes. Every item is written in the planner's own words, one or two sentences, with the link it came from; never copied text. Entries older than 60 days are dropped.

entries.summary: Latest hotfixes (19 and 20 November): dungeon resets cut to 5 per hour, fixes for Rogue, Warlock and Retribution; WoWSims made the Druid dungeon set bonuses work.

items.title: Dungeon resets halved (20 Nov)
items.text: A character can now reset and enter each dungeon at most 5 times per hour instead of 10. Short farm runs for a single boss hit that limit sooner, so plan fewer, longer runs.

items.title: Rogue: Blade Flurry and Shank (20 Nov)
items.text: For Combat, Shank's damage now also reaches the second target while Blade Flurry is up, as it was meant to.

items.title: Warlock: Demonic Aegis loophole closed (20 Nov)
items.text: Demonology could keep the talent's bonus on Demon Armor or Demon Skin after dropping the talent. Both are now removed when talents are unlearned.

items.title: Paladin: two-hand specialization fixed (19 Nov)
items.text: Retribution's Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now raises all Holy damage while a two-hander is equipped, which makes two-handers a little stronger for Retribution than before.

items.title: Skyborne and Tauren racial fixes (20 Nov)
items.text: Skyborne get their riding discount at Honored reputation, and the Tauren's Cultivation works more reliably on herbs they can pick, Purple Lotus included.

items.title: Seed Hybridizer is back (19 Nov)
items.text: The camping feature was switched on again with changed values and a chance to fail; scarce herb seeds can no longer go into it.

items.title: Quest, item and dungeon fixes (19 Nov)
items.text: The parchment for the Alterac quest "Stormpike's Deciphering" can be had again after destroying it, Motes of Unstable Magic are now soulbound, and the Shade of the Archmage in Dalaran no longer vanishes when the fight starts.

items.title: Wildheart and Feralheart set bonuses work
items.text: The Druid dungeon sets now restore energy on swings and rage when struck in the simulator, and the Wildheart 5-piece bonus is no longer marked as partly implemented.

items.title: Random suffix items pick their best suffix
items.text: A change named "random suffix best EP" was merged: going by its name, the simulator can now pick the suffix worth the most for a build.
